Package org.smtlib

Class SMT.Configuration

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.SMT.Configuration
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, SMT.IConfiguration
Enclosing class:
SMT
public static class SMT.Configuration extends Object implements Cloneable, SMT.IConfiguration
The configuration object holds the values of all of the current options (e.g. command-line settings); it also holds factory objects that are used to create objects for the particular concrete syntax being used; it also holds a few internal state values

    • stdout

      public PrintStream stdout
      The PrintStream that "stdout" resolves to for this instance. Defaults to System.out; in-process callers (e.g. JUnit tests) set this to a per-test stream so that set_option(:regular-output-channel "stdout") does not escape the capture.

    • stderr

      public PrintStream stderr
      The PrintStream that "stderr" resolves to for this instance. Defaults to System.err; in-process callers (e.g. JUnit tests) set this to a per-test stream so that set_option(:diagnostic-output-channel "stderr") does not escape the capture.
